title: Monster template
description: A reusable change a monster row applies with templates: [...] (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates). Each template fills one slot, a row holds at most one per slot, and the slots apply element, power, then nature, after the base and before the row's overrides.

slot.description: Which slot the template fills: element (the five phases), power (dire, elder, ancient), or nature (demonic, angelic, otherworldly).

label_prefix.description: Put before the monster's label, with a space, unless the row's overrides give a label.

phase.description: The monster's phase, and the phase of every attack.

loot.description: Rows added to the monster's loot.

damage_type.description: The damage type of every attack that does not name its own, and the element each elemental damage_* ability turns into.

attributes.description: Added to the monster's attributes, a missing one counting 0. An END add moves an authored hitPoints by the hp row's per_point.

resist.description: Added to the monster's resist, per damage type.

spells.description: Appended to the monster's spells, skipping any it has.

perks.description: Added to the monster's perks; when both name a perk, the higher rank is kept (M3-15).

tags.description: Appended to the monster's tags, skipping any it has.
